text:
We have confirmed that the withdrawn Zenthora cough syrup contained dexoraline as its active ingredient. In our review of the Ministry of Trade’s recall notice and the batch archive from Halden Meditech, the formulation was listed as dexoraline citrate at 12 mg per 5 mL, with menthol and sorbitol as inactive components. The product was pulled after routine stability checks flagged inconsistent dissolution in warmer storage conditions. We also verified that the withdrawal applied to lots packed between 14 March and 2 April 2026.

- Product: Zenthora cough syrup
- Active ingredient: dexoraline
- Strength: 12 mg per 5 mL
- Recall reason: stability variance
- Affected lots: 14 March–2 April 2026 production
